label: Saturated reset gate dips late in episodes, most at D1 after an a1 rare-to-S2 trial.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state > prev_action) * (ep_dec == 9) ;; (phase != D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (ep_dec == 9) ;; (prev_reward == 1) * (ep_dec == 9) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state > prev_action) ;; (phase != D1) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state > prev_action) * (ep_dec == 8) ;; (phase != D1) * belief_lo * (ep_dec == 9) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (ep_dec == 9) * (prev_action == 2)
explanation: r13 sits at ~0.99-1.0 and its variance is mostly a timing effect (sags in the last episode decile, included in baseline). Beyond timing, the clearest observed driver is a drop at D1 after the previous trial was a1 reaching S2 (rare), amplified strongly in the last decile; at GO/D2 it is a little lower when the previous choice was a1 (and when belief favours S1), again mostly late; previous reward slightly raises it late. Free fit adds the same effects without the late gating plus decile-8 terms and a late a2-rewarded dip (test 0.23 vs short 0.19). This exceeds the profile additive ceiling (~0.13) because the effects are multiplicative with lateness, but large late-episode dips (e.g. 0.67 at D1 after a2 S2 r) remain unexplained; a small, history-dependent modulation of a saturated gate.
